purpose: Teach: 単体/序盤/ワイルド/くわえ/不都合/幾度/当り/きまっ

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、このおもちゃは単体では遊べないわよ
lines.en: Sho, that toy won't work by itself, you know.
lines.style: Patient, matter-of-fact. Gentle correction without condescension. A mother explaining something practical she's noticed. Warm eye contact, no rush.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お話の序盤からドキドキしたよ
lines.en: Mom, the story had me on the edge of my seat from the very beginning!
lines.style: Bright, genuine excitement bubbling up. Quick words tumbling over each other. The enthusiasm is authentic, not performed. Slight breathlessness.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さん、ワイルドな性格よね
lines.en: Sho, your dad has quite the wild personality, doesn't he.
lines.style: Warm observation wrapped in soft amusement. Not criticizing—noticing something familiar and a little fond. Slight lift at the end, inviting agreement.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お祖父ちゃんがパイプをくわえてたよ
lines.en: Mom, Grandpa was holding his pipe in his mouth the whole time.
lines.style: Quiet, observant report. The tone of a child noticing something specific and reporting it without editorial comment. Matter-of-fact, almost wondering.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、不都合なことがあれば、ママに言ってね
lines.en: Sho, if anything feels uncomfortable or wrong, you come tell me, okay?
lines.style: Steady, present reassurance. Not anxious—firm but warm. The words matter, so she takes a slight pause before the 'okay.' Maternal certainty.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、幾度もお父さんに教えてもらったよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad's taught me so many things. I've learned from him lots of times.
lines.style: Soft wonder in the voice. A child reflecting on accumulated kindness. Thoughtful pace, not eager to move on. Traces of pride without boasting.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、明日の予報、晴れの当りそうね
lines.en: Sho, the forecast for tomorrow is looking clear, it seems.
lines.style: Light observation, almost thinking aloud. The kind of practical small talk a mother makes while being present. Calm, conversational, no particular urgency.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お祖父ちゃんの来訪日がきまったよ
lines.en: Mom, we decided when Grandpa's coming to visit!
lines.style: Bright, warm excitement with an undertone of closeness. The news matters because it's shared. Quick upbeat delivery. A smile in the voice.
